Name: whitebalverines Indian Animals for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from whitebalverines, I have converted their BFAV Indian Animal Pack (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6941) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to whitebalverines for the original mod. 

This mod includes:
Asil Chickens (live in coops, produce eggs)
Guinea Fowl (live in coops, produce eggs)
White-Faced Black Spanish Chickens ( live in coops, produce eggs)
Kadaknath Chickens (live in coops, produce eggs)
Runner Ducks (live in coops, produce duck eggs)
Jamnapari Goats (live in barns, produce goat milk)
Indian Boars (live in barns, dig up truffles)
Black and Brown Dangi (live in barns, produce milk)

Enjoy!
